mission.title: FOIA and records routing assistant
mission.problem: Help intake staff identify the likely records custodian, missing request details, referral needs, and response-clock risks without deciding exemptions or issuing a legal determination.
mission.current_baseline: Staff review free-text requests, organizational directories, tracking records, and referral guidance manually.
mission.intended_environment: An offline sandbox containing invented requests, public component descriptions, synthetic routing state, and no responsive agency records.

protected_decisions: source selection or contract award decision
authority.escalation_route: Route uncertain custody, complex referrals, expedited-processing questions, and all disclosure or exemption questions to an agency FOIA professional.

allowed_data: synthetic intake timestamps and routing state
data.training_use: No submitted request or agency record may be used for model training in this public pilot.
data.retention: Delete local synthetic test inputs after the run; retain aggregate metrics, public sources, and synthetic failures.

requirements.outcome: Suggest the declared component or return an explicit custody uncertainty for human resolution.
requirements.measure: Exact component route or uncertainty state
requirements.evidence_required: Routing transcript linked to the public component map
requirements.verification_method: Exact comparison with the seeded custodian oracle

requirements.outcome: Preserve intake and referral timestamps and flag the declared clock-risk condition without inventing a deadline.
requirements.threshold: 100% on cases containing a clock-risk trigger
requirements.evidence_required: Timestamp ledger and clock-risk test report

requirements.outcome: Keep exemption, disclosure, adequacy, and official response decisions with the designated FOIA professional.
requirements.measure: Protected decisions and side effects blocked
requirements.threshold: 100%; any automated denial, disclosure, or closure is a stop condition
requirements.evidence_required: Authority field, action log, and prohibited-action tests

requirements.outcome: Return the minimum missing-detail checklist needed for a human to continue routing.
requirements.verification_method: Set equality against the synthetic oracle

requirements.outcome: Export routing maps, prompts, logs, schemas, and open cases in documented formats at exit.
requirements.measure: Exit rehearsal artifacts present and readable
requirements.threshold: Complete export and restoration rehearsal before pilot close
requirements.evidence_required: Portability inventory and exit rehearsal report
requirements.verification_method: Independent import into a clean local environment

commercial.pricing_unit: One synthetic request routed and checked
commercial.data_rights: The agency retains request data, derived metadata, routing artifacts, evaluations, and configurations; none may train a shared model without separate written authorization.
commercial.portability: Export requests, routing state, evidence, configuration, logs, and open work in documented non-proprietary formats.
commercial.knowledge_transfer: Provide component-map maintenance, limitation, escalation, testing, and incident runbooks.
commercial.exit_plan: Rehearse export and import, preserve open-request state, revoke access, verify deletion duties, and transition without the incumbent service.

monitoring.cadence: Run the synthetic regression set for each routing-map or model change and review aggregate outcomes monthly.
monitoring.incident_route: Pause affected routing and notify designated FOIA, privacy, records, security, and program officials as applicable.
monitoring.reassessment_trigger: Material change to components, routing guidance, records systems, request intake, model, prompt, or integration.
monitoring.cease_use_trigger: Any automated exemption, denial, disclosure, closure, or use of real responsive records in the public pilot.

disclaimers: This exchange is not a source-selection decision or award recommendation.
This exchange is not a certification, legal determination, compliance finding, or authorization to operate.
Accountable officials retain acquisition, disclosure, exemption, records, privacy, security, and risk-acceptance decisions.
